block.description: CoreXY calibration. Homes Y against the Y-min switch first to establish the Y origin, parks the gantry a short distance clear of that switch, then probes X min and X max and measures X steps per centimetre from the entered track length. A limit switch already pressed at the start is nudged clear rather than treated as an error.

inputs.label: Selected ESP32
inputs.description: Connected ESP32 board that should run the X calibration routine.

inputs.label: X Track Length (cm)
inputs.description: Physical X travel in cm between the X-min and X-max limit switches.

inputs.label: Y Track Length (cm)
inputs.description: Physical Y travel in cm from the Y-min switch to the far end. Y is homed against the Y-min switch, which defines Y = 0; this value sets the Y track length used to bound later moves.

inputs.label: X Start Clearance (cm)
inputs.description: First move of the calibration: the gantry steps this far in +X before homing, so a mounted tool clears the tool holders before Y homes. Uses the estimated steps-per-cm; stops safely on the X-max switch if already at the far end. Set 0 to skip.

inputs.label: X Calibration Y (cm)
inputs.description: Y position in cm the gantry parks at, clear of the Y-min switch, while X is calibrated. Parked using the carried-over steps-per-cm estimate, then corrected onto this exact value once X measures the true steps per cm.

inputs.label: Limit Buffer (cm)
inputs.description: Safety gap kept between the usable workspace and every limit switch. User coordinate 0 sits this far off the min switch and the usable max is the track length minus one buffer at each end, so moves to 0 or to the max stop short of the switches instead of tripping them. Changing it re-derives the ranges on the move blocks.

inputs.label: X End Clearance (cm)
inputs.description: Last move of the calibration: after homing X-max the gantry retreats at least this far from the X-max switch (never less than the limit buffer), so it finishes well clear of the switch and anything mounted at the far end.

inputs.label: Calibration Speed (RPM)
inputs.description: Numeric motor speed used while probing X limits.

inputs.label: Trapezoidal Speed
inputs.description: Enable acceleration and deceleration ramping instead of jumping directly to target speed.

inputs.label: Acceleration (RPM/s)
inputs.description: Acceleration and deceleration rate used for trapezoidal speed ramping.

inputs.label: Steps per Rotation
inputs.description: Stepper pulse count for one full motor rotation. Use 800 when the driver is configured for 800 steps per rotation.

inputs.label: Max Probe Rotations
inputs.description: Maximum motor rotations allowed for each X limit-switch probe before calibration stops with a safety error.

block.description: Pick up a gantry toolhead from the rack. Approaches the slot at the chosen speed, then engages at a fixed 50 RPM: onto the tool, dip along -Y, lift back to seat it, and withdraw along +X. If another toolhead is already held it is dropped into its own slot first. Errors before moving if the sequence would leave the usable workspace.

inputs.label: Selected ESP32
inputs.description: Connected ESP32 board that drives the CoreXY gantry.

inputs.label: Toolhead
inputs.description: Which toolhead to pick up (1-6). If a different toolhead is already held it is automatically returned to its own slot first.

inputs.label: Approach Speed (RPM)
inputs.description: Speed for the initial approach move only. Every step after it runs at a fixed 50 RPM.

inputs.label: Check Tool Contact
inputs.description: Once the tool is hooked and seated (after the dip and lift), wait and check that TXD and RXD are shorted through the tool's pogo pins. On a miss the tool is unhooked back into its slot, the head backs out to the clearance position, and it picks the tool up again. Only for tools wired with that short.

inputs.label: Contact Retries
inputs.description: How many more times to put the tool back and pick it up again after a failed contact check. 0 fails on the first miss, with the tool left in its slot.

advancedInputs.label: Pickup Clearance (cm)
advancedInputs.description: How far clear of the rack the head sits before and after collecting a tool.

advancedInputs.label: Drop Clearance (cm)
advancedInputs.description: How far clear of the rack the head sits before and after returning a tool. Usually larger than the pickup clearance: a carried tool sticks out further than the bare carriage.

advancedInputs.label: Dip Depth (cm)
advancedInputs.description: How far along -Y the gantry pulls to engage or release a tool. Needs this much room below the tool.

advancedInputs.label: Engage Lift (cm)
advancedInputs.description: Small +Y move back after the dip that seats the tool on the gantry.

advancedInputs.label: Release Offset (cm)
advancedInputs.description: How far along +Y the gantry rises past the slot position to unhook the tool before settling back onto the slot Y. The drop retraces the pickup exit path.

advancedInputs.label: Contact Settle (s)
advancedInputs.description: How long to wait with the tool seated before checking contact.

advancedInputs.label: Rack Approach Speed (RPM)

advancedInputs.label: Home Probe Speed (RPM)
advancedInputs.description: Speed of the X and Y re-home probes during a tool change. Slow enough to stop on the switch without overshooting, fast enough not to make every tool change a wait.

block.description: Trace a full circle with the CoreXY gantry around a given center (X, Y) position with a given radius, using trapezoidal acceleration over the whole lap. Moves to the circle start point first. Requires a prior Calibrate Gantry XY run. Errors and stops immediately if the circle does not fit the workspace or a limit switch is hit.

inputs.label: Selected ESP32
inputs.description: Connected ESP32 board that drives the CoreXY gantry.

inputs.label: Center X (cm)
inputs.description: Absolute X position of the circle center in cm. 0 is the safe X-min end (5 mm off the switch); the max is the X track length minus the 5 mm buffer at each end. The whole circle must also fit inside this range.

inputs.label: Center Y (cm)
inputs.description: Absolute Y position of the circle center in cm. 0 is the safe Y-min end (5 mm off the switch); the max is the Y track length minus the 5 mm buffer at each end. The whole circle must also fit inside this range.

inputs.label: Radius (cm)
inputs.description: Circle radius in cm. The whole circle must fit inside the calibrated workspace.

inputs.label: Repeat Count
inputs.description: Number of full circles to trace before continuing.

inputs.label: Move Speed (RPM)
inputs.description: Numeric target motor speed for the circle move.

inputs.label: Trapezoidal Speed
inputs.description: Ramp acceleration and deceleration over the whole circle instead of jumping straight to target speed.

inputs.label: Acceleration (RPM/s)
inputs.description: Acceleration and deceleration rate used for trapezoidal speed ramping.

advancedInputs.description: How far clear of the rack the head sits before and after collecting a tool.

advancedInputs.label: Drop Clearance (cm)
advancedInputs.description: How far clear of the rack the head sits before and after returning a tool. Usually larger than the pickup clearance: a carried tool sticks out further than the bare carriage.

advancedInputs.label: Dip Depth (cm)
advancedInputs.description: How far along -Y the gantry pulls to engage or release a tool. Needs this much room below the tool.

advancedInputs.label: Engage Lift (cm)
advancedInputs.description: Small +Y move back after the dip that seats the tool on the gantry.

advancedInputs.label: Release Offset (cm)
advancedInputs.description: How far along +Y the gantry rises past the slot position to unhook the tool before settling back onto the slot Y. The drop retraces the pickup exit path.

advancedInputs.label: Re-check X Home
advancedInputs.description: Re-touch the X min switch at the clearance position before engaging the tool, and correct the tracked X position from it. Costs a short probe; recovers any steps X has lost since the last home. Y is not touched.

advancedInputs.label: Rack Approach Speed (RPM)
advancedInputs.description: Speed for the move across to the tool's Y once the head is at the rack. Separate from the main approach speed because this move ends where engagement begins.

advancedInputs.label: Home Probe Speed (RPM)
advancedInputs.description: Speed of the X and Y re-home probes during a tool change. Slow enough to stop on the switch without overshooting, fast enough not to make every tool change a wait.

outputs.label: Next
outputs.description: Continue when the tool change completes.

block.description: Homes both Z motors independently: each side drives down to its min limit switch (sets 0), then up to its max limit switch, using the entered track length as the expected travel. The actual measured travel becomes the calibrated range for later Move Z Axis calls.

inputs.label: Selected ESP32
inputs.description: Connected ESP32 board running the dual Z-axis controller firmware.

inputs.label: Axes to Calibrate
inputs.description: Which Z side(s) to home. Use a single side during bring-up when the other motor is unpowered or being worked on - the skipped side keeps whatever calibration it already had. Move Z Axis still requires both sides to have been calibrated at some point.

inputs.label: Z Left Track Length (cm)
inputs.description: Expected physical travel of the left Z axis between its min and max limit switches.

inputs.label: Z Right Track Length (cm)
inputs.description: Expected physical travel of the right Z axis between its min and max limit switches.

inputs.label: Limit Buffer (cm)
inputs.description: Safety gap kept between the usable range and each max limit switch. Calibration parks this far off the max switch when it finishes, so it never leaves a switch pressed, and later moves are capped at track length minus this buffer.

inputs.label: Calibration Speed (RPM)
inputs.description: Motor speed used while homing both Z axes.

inputs.label: Trapezoidal Speed
inputs.description: Enable acceleration and deceleration ramping instead of jumping directly to target speed.

inputs.label: Acceleration (RPM/s)
inputs.description: Acceleration and deceleration rate used for trapezoidal speed ramping.

advancedInputs.label: Steps per cm (estimate)
advancedInputs.description: Rough steps-per-cm of the Z drive, used only to decide how far homing is allowed to travel before giving up. It does not affect the result - calibration measures the real value. Set it too low and homing stops part way down the axis; too high only makes a genuine failure take longer to report.

advancedInputs.label: Z Left Step Pin
advancedInputs.description: Runtime GPIO pin for z left step pin.

advancedInputs.label: Z Left Dir Pin
advancedInputs.description: Runtime GPIO pin for z left dir pin.

advancedInputs.label: Z Right Step Pin
advancedInputs.description: Runtime GPIO pin for z right step pin.

advancedInputs.description: Runtime GPIO pin for z right dir pin.

advancedInputs.description: Runtime GPIO pin for z left min limit pin.

advancedInputs.label: Z Left Max Limit Pin
advancedInputs.description: Runtime GPIO pin for z left max limit pin.

advancedInputs.label: Z Right Min Limit Pin
advancedInputs.description: Runtime GPIO pin for z right min limit pin.

advancedInputs.label: Z Right Max Limit Pin
advancedInputs.description: Runtime GPIO pin for z right max limit pin.
